positions.title: IT Application Programmer 2
positions.locationName: Baton Rouge, Louisiana, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Key Achievements:

1) Engineered an automated process using C# and Oracle PL/SQL enabling the retirement department to identify deceased members based on weekly data from the Department of Health.

2) Developed a RESTful web service using C# and Entity Framework to facilitate user action and input logging across multiple .NET web applications.

3) Created .NET web applications for members and internal employees using C#, Visual Basic, JavaScript, and Oracle PL/SQL to enable calculation of retirement benefit estimates.

4) Introduced automated unit testing for .NET web applications using xUnit and C#

positions.title: Applications Development Intern
positions.description:
Key Achievements:

1) Created a Xamarin Forms mobile app in C# for public safety officials to view active emergencies, communicate with dispatchers via MMS, and receive push notifications for event status updates

2) Developed a C# .NET application that allows booking officers to store and query criminal warrant information from a SQL database

3) Attended daily stand-ups, sprint planning meetings, sprint reviews, and code reviews
